hooks.name: Listen to the reference song after an engine change
hooks.description: Renders a fixed song after any song-engine change and compares the Listener's findings with the stored baseline (kiro-craft spec 12, requirement 2.2).

action.command: cd backend && (nohup venv/bin/python scripts/listen_reference.py > .reference_report.log 2>&1 &) && echo "Rendering the reference song in the background; result in backend/.reference_report.txt (a NEW likely problem makes it say so)."
